description: The gallery and the buy box of one product.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A product page: a gallery (the main picture and optional thumbnails) beside the buy box (badge, rating, price,
  stock, quantity, add button, shipping and returns notes). Axes: layout (split, stacked), media side, thumbs
  (none, below), buy (full, compact), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { ProductDetailLabels } from "./product-detail.types";
import type { Product } from "./product-card.types";

export type ProductDetailProps = {
  id: string;
  product?: Product;
  labels: ProductDetailLabels;
  badges: Record<string, string>;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  layout?: "split" | "stacked";
  mediaSide?: "start" | "end";
  thumbs?: "none" | "below";
  buy?: "full" | "compact";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "roomy";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import NumberField from "../components/number-field.vue";
import ProductGallery from "../components/product-gallery.vue";
import ProductPrice from "../components/product-price.vue";
import Rating from "../components/rating.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { at, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  product,
  labels,
  badges,
  level = 1,
  layout = "split",
  mediaSide = "start",
  thumbs = "below",
  buy = "full",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ProductDetailProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ add: [id: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame v-if="!product" :id="id" :tone="tone" :density="density" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState icon="package" :title="labels.empty" />
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-else
    :id="id"
    :title="product?.name"
    :lead="product?.summary"
    :heading="{ level }"
    :layout="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'split' : 'stack')"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide, align: 'start' }"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-slot="buy-box">
      <Text
        v-if="product?.category"
        size="xs"
        class="uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground"
        data-slot="category"
      >
        {{ product?.category }}
      </Text>
      <ProductPrice
        :price="product?.price"
        :compareAt="product?.compareAt"
        :currency="product?.currency"
        :badge="(product?.badge ? at(badges, product?.badge) : '')"
        :was="labels.was"
      />
      <Group gap="2">
        <Rating :value="product?.rating" :label="tpl(labels.ratingLabel, product?.rating)" />
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ tpl(labels.reviews, product?.reviews) }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Text
        size="sm"
        weight="medium"
        :class="(product?.inStock ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-destructive')"
        data-slot="stock"
      >
        {{ (product?.inStock ? labels.inStock : labels.soldOut) }}
      </Text>
      <Group gap="4" class="flex-wrap">
        <NumberField v-if="((buy as string) === 'full')"
          value="1"
          :name="tpl('{0}-qty', id)"
          min="1"
          :label="labels.qty"
          :decrease="labels.decrease"
          :increase="labels.increase"
        />
        <Button :disabled="!product?.inStock" @click="() => emit('add', product?.id)">
          {{ labels.add }}
        </Button>
      </Group>
      <List v-if="((buy as string) === 'full')" tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <LucideIcon name="truck" :size="16" />
          <Inline>
            {{ labels.shipping }}
          </Inline>
        </ListItem>
        <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <LucideIcon name="shield-check" :size="16" />
          <Inline>
            {{ labels.returns }}
          </Inline>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
    </Stack>
    <template #aside>
      <ProductGallery :name="product?.name" :image="product?.image" :thumbs="thumbs" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
